steps.stdout:
--api-key	API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
--api-url	Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
--human	force human-readable output, even through a pipe
--jq	filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
--json	force JSON output
--project	project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
--timeout	per-request timeout
--workspace	workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)
--assignee	user id to assign
--attach	attach this session to the new task, as `session attach` would
--description	task description; - reads stdin
--description-file	read the description from a file; - reads stdin
--due-date	due date
--force	create the task even when an open task names the same reference
--help	help for create
--next	first step to record on the new task; needs --attach
--priority	urgent, high, medium, low or no-priority (default medium)
--start-date	start date: a date, or a date and time with an offset
--status	column slug to create the task in (default to-do)
:4
